<nowiki />
|translation='''Title:''' Death Star Trooper.

'''Card text:''' Deploy only on the Death Star. May move to other systems. Power −1 at locations other than the Death Star.

'''Lore:''' Elite soldiers skilled in tactics and weapons. One of them, Devin Cant, was assigned as a guard for Princess Leia in Detention Block AA-23.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese specifies movement to other systems and applies the power reduction at locations other than the Death Star. The English permits movement elsewhere and specifies a site other than a Death Star site.
